WITH AnnualConsumption AS (
    SELECT 
        c.Segment,
        AVG(ym.Consumption) AS AvgConsumption
    FROM 
        yearmonth ym
    JOIN 
        customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE 
        ym.Date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312'
    GROUP BY 
        c.Segment, c.CustomerID
),
MinConsumption AS (
    SELECT 
        Segment,
        MIN(AvgConsumption) AS MinAvgConsumption
    FROM 
        AnnualConsumption
    GROUP BY 
        Segment
),
AnnualAverage AS (
    SELECT 
        a.Segment,
        a.AvgConsumption - m.MinAvgConsumption AS AnnualAvg
    FROM 
        AnnualConsumption a
    JOIN 
        MinConsumption m ON a.Segment = m.Segment
)
SELECT 
    (SELECT AnnualAvg FROM AnnualAverage WHERE Segment = 'SME') - 
    (SELECT AnnualAvg FROM AnnualAverage WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS SME_LAM_Difference,
    (SELECT AnnualAvg FROM AnnualAverage WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - 
    (SELECT AnnualAvg FROM AnnualAverage WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS LAM_KAM_Difference,
    (SELECT AnnualAvg FROM AnnualAverage WHERE Segment = 'KAM') - 
    (SELECT AnnualAvg FROM AnnualAverage WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS KAM_SME_Difference
FROM 
    AnnualAverage
LIMIT 1;

WITH Consumption AS (
    SELECT 
        strftime('%Y', Date) AS Year,
        Segment,
        SUM(Consumption) AS TotalConsumption
    FROM 
        yearmonth
    WHERE 
        strftime('%Y', Date) IN ('2012', '2013')
    GROUP BY 
        Year, Segment
),
ConsumptionChange AS (
    SELECT 
        c1.Segment,
        c1.TotalConsumption AS Consumption2013,
        c2.TotalConsumption AS Consumption2012,
        (c1.TotalConsumption - c2.TotalConsumption) AS Increase,
        ((c1.TotalConsumption - c2.TotalConsumption) / c1.TotalConsumption) * 100 AS PercentageIncrease
    FROM 
        Consumption c1
    JOIN 
        Consumption c2 ON c1.Segment = c2.Segment AND c2.Year = '2012' AND c1.Year = '2013'
)
SELECT 
    Segment,
    PercentageIncrease
FROM 
    ConsumptionChange
ORDER BY 
    PercentageIncrease ASC;

JOIN drivers d ON res.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE d.forename = 'Michael' AND d.surname = 'Schumacher' AND res.fastestLap = 1

SELECT r.name AS race_name, res.points
FROM results res
JOIN races r ON res.raceId = r.raceId
JOIN drivers d ON res.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE d.forename = 'Lewis' AND d.surname = 'Hamilton'
AND r.year = (SELECT MIN(year) FROM races r2
              JOIN results res2 ON r2.raceId = res2.raceId
              JOIN drivers d2 ON res2.driverId = d2.driverId
              WHERE d2.forename = 'Lewis' AND d2.surname = 'Hamilton');

SELECT nationality 
FROM drivers 
ORDER BY dob ASC 
LIMIT 1;

SELECT d.driverRef
FROM results r
JOIN races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId
JOIN drivers d ON r.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE ra.year = 2007 AND ra.name = 'Canadian Grand Prix' AND r.position = 1;

SELECT r.name, r.year, r.round
FROM results res
JOIN races r ON res.raceId = r.raceId
JOIN drivers d ON res.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE d.forename = 'Lewis' AND d.surname = 'Hamilton'
ORDER BY res.rank ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT MAX(fastestLapSpeed) AS fastestLapSpeed
FROM results
JOIN races ON results.raceId = races.raceId
WHERE races.name = 'Spanish Grand Prix';

SELECT r.positionOrder 
FROM results r 
JOIN races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId 
JOIN drivers d ON r.driverId = d.driverId 
WHERE d.forename = 'Lewis' AND d.surname = 'Hamilton' AND ra.name = 'Chinese Grand Prix';

SELECT r.time 
FROM results AS res
JOIN races AS r ON res.raceId = r.raceId
WHERE r.name = 'Chinese Grand Prix' 
  AND r.year = 2008 
  AND res.position = 2;

SELECT 
    (CAST((last_driver.milliseconds - champion.milliseconds) AS REAL) / last_driver.milliseconds) * 100 AS percentage_faster
FROM 
    (SELECT 
        r.time, 
        r.milliseconds 
     FROM 
        results r 
     JOIN 
        races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId 
     WHERE 
        ra.year = 2008 AND 
        ra.name = 'Australian Grand Prix' AND 
        r.position = 1 AND 
        r.time IS NOT NULL) AS champion,
    (SELECT 
        r.time, 
        r.milliseconds 
     FROM 
        results r 
     JOIN 
        races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId 
     WHERE 
        ra.year = 2008 AND 
        ra.name = 'Australian Grand Prix' AND 
        r.position = (SELECT MAX(position) FROM results WHERE raceId = r.raceId) AND 
        r.time IS NOT NULL) AS last_driver;

SELECT MAX(points) AS max_points
FROM constructors
JOIN constructorResults ON constructors.constructorId = constructorResults.constructorId
WHERE constructors.nationality = 'British';

SELECT c.name 
FROM constructors c
JOIN constructorResults cr ON c.constructorId = cr.constructorId
WHERE cr.raceId = 291 AND cr.points = 0;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.constructorId) AS JapaneseConstructorsWithZeroPoints
FROM constructors c
JOIN constructorResults cr ON c.constructorId = cr.constructorId
WHERE c.nationality = 'Japanese' AND cr.points = 0
GROUP BY c.constructorId
HAVING COUNT(cr.raceId) = 2;

SELECT year, AVG(milliseconds) AS average_time_seconds
FROM results
JOIN races ON results.raceId = races.raceId
WHERE races.year < 1975 AND results.time IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY year;

SELECT r.fastestLap
FROM results r
JOIN driverStandings ds ON r.driverId = ds.driverId
JOIN races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId
WHERE ds.position = 1 AND ra.year = 2009;

SELECT 
    (COUNT(DISTINCT l.driverId) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT r.driverId), 0)) AS percentage
FROM 
    results r
JOIN 
    drivers d ON r.driverId = d.driverId
JOIN 
    lapTimes l ON r.raceId = l.raceId AND r.driverId = l.driverId
WHERE 
    d.dob < '1985-01-01' 
    AND r.year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2005 
    AND l.lap > 50;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.driverId) AS FrenchDriversUnderTwoMinutes
FROM drivers d
JOIN lapTimes lt ON d.driverId = lt.driverId
WHERE d.nationality = 'French' AND lt.time < '02:00.00';

SELECT code 
FROM drivers 
ORDER BY dob DESC 
LIMIT 3;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS circuit_count, location, lat, lng 
FROM circuits 
WHERE country = 'Austria' 
GROUP BY location, lat, lng;

SELECT d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, MIN(r.date) AS first_qualifying_date, r.time
FROM drivers d
JOIN qualifying q ON d.driverId = q.driverId
JOIN races r ON q.raceId = r.raceId
WHERE d.dob = (SELECT MAX(dob) FROM drivers)
GROUP BY d.driverId

SELECT d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS full_name, 
       AVG(p.milliseconds) AS avg_duration
FROM drivers d
JOIN pitStops p ON d.driverId = p.driverId
WHERE d.nationality = 'German' 
  AND strftime('%Y', d.dob) BETWEEN '1980' AND '1985'
GROUP BY d.driverId
ORDER BY avg_duration ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS champion, r.time
FROM results res
JOIN races r ON res.raceId = r.raceId
JOIN drivers d ON res.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE r.year = 2008 AND r.name = 'Canadian Grand Prix' AND res.position = 1;

SELECT d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS full_name
FROM qualifying q
JOIN races r ON q.raceId = r.raceId
JOIN drivers d ON q.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE r.year = 2008 AND r.round = 3 AND q.position = 1;

SELECT 
    d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS full_name, 
    d.nationality, 
    r.name AS race_name
FROM 
    drivers d
JOIN 
    results res ON d.driverId = res.driverId
JOIN 
    races r ON res.raceId = r.raceId
WHERE 
    d.dob = (SELECT MAX(dob) FROM drivers)
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS accident_count
FROM results r
JOIN races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId
WHERE ra.name = 'Canadian Grand Prix' 
AND r.statusId = 3
AND r.driverId = (
    SELECT driverId
    FROM results
    JOIN races ON results.raceId = races.raceId
    WHERE races.name = 'Canadian Grand Prix'

    ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
    LIMIT 1
);

SELECT d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS full_name
FROM lapTimes lt
JOIN drivers d ON lt.driverId = d.driverId
ORDER BY lt.milliseconds ASC
LIMIT 20;

SELECT l.raceId, l.driverId, l.lap, l.time, l.milliseconds, c.name AS circuitName
FROM lapTimes l
JOIN races r ON l.raceId = r.raceId
JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId

ORDER BY l.raceId, l.lap;

SELECT superhero_name, height_cm
FROM superhero
JOIN publisher ON superhero.publisher_id = publisher.id
WHERE publisher.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'
ORDER BY height_cm DESC;

SELECT c.colour, COUNT(s.id) AS superhero_count
FROM superhero s

JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'
GROUP BY c.colour
ORDER BY superhero_count DESC;

SELECT 
    (COUNT(CASE WHEN a.alignment = 'Bad' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(s.id)) AS percentage,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN a.alignment = 'Bad' AND p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 END) AS marvel_count
FROM 
    superhero s
JOIN 
    alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
JOIN 
    publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id;

SELECT superhero_name 
FROM superhero 
WHERE height_cm BETWEEN 170 AND 190 
AND eye_colour_id IS NULL;

SELECT c.colour 
FROM superhero s 
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id 
JOIN colour c ON s.hair_colour_id = c.id 
WHERE s.height_cm = 185 AND r.race = 'human';

SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero s

);

SELECT s.superhero_name

JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id

LIMIT 1;

SELECT c1.colour AS eye_colour, c2.colour AS hair_colour, c3.colour AS skin_colour
FROM superhero s

JOIN colour c2 ON s.hair_colour_id = c2.id

SELECT

FROM 
    superhero s

    gender g ON s.gender_id = g.id
JOIN 
    colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id

SELECT AVG(height_cm) AS average_height FROM superhero;

SELECT

        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM superhero s JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id WHERE p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics')

SELECT p.FavoriteCount

JOIN comments c ON p.Id = c.PostId
WHERE c.UserId = 3025 AND c.CreationDate = '2014-04-23 20:29:39';

SELECT p.ClosedDate IS NULL AS IsWellFinished

SELECT u.DisplayName

SELECT p.Title, ph.Comment, AVG(p.ViewCount) AS AverageViewCount

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT UserId) AS UserCount

GROUP BY UserId
HAVING COUNT(Name) > 5;

SELECT u.Id, u.DisplayName

SELECT OwnerDisplayName, MAX(ViewCount) AS MaxViewCount
FROM posts

LIMIT 1;

SELECT

FROM 
    posts
JOIN 
    users ON posts.OwnerUserId = users.Id
LEFT JOIN 
    tags ON posts.Id = tags.ExcerptPostId

SELECT COUNT(Id) / 12.0 AS AverageMonthlyLinks
FROM postLinks
WHERE YEAR(CreationDate) = 2010 
AND PostId IN (

    FROM posts 
    WHERE AnswerCount <= 2
);

SELECT p.Id, p.OwnerDisplayName
FROM posts p
WHERE p.FavoriteCount = (
    SELECT MAX(FavoriteCount)
    FROM posts
    WHERE strftime('%Y', CreationDate) = '2010'
)
AND strftime('%Y', p.CreationDate) = '2010';

SELECT 
    (COUNT(CASE WHEN u.Reputation > 1000 THEN p.Id END) * 100.0 / COUNT(p.Id)) AS percentage
FROM 
    posts p
JOIN 
    users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE 
    strftime('%Y', p.CreaionDate) = '2011';

SELECT p.ViewCount, u.DisplayName
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.LastEditorUserId = u.Id
WHERE p.Title = 'Computer Game Datasets';

SELECT c.Text, c.UserDisplayName
FROM comments c
JOIN posts p ON c.PostId = p.Id
WHERE p.Title = 'Analysing wind data with R'
ORDER BY c.CreationDate DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM comments

AND Score = 0;
SELECT * FROM cards WHERE cardKingdomFoilId IS NOT NULL AND cardKingdomId IS NOT NULL;

SELECT c.*
FROM cards c
JOIN legalities l ON c.uuid = l.uuid

SELECT

SELECT c.name, c.artist
FROM cards c

WHERE c.isPromo = 1
GROUP BY c.uuid
ORDER BY COUNT(r.uuid) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT r.text

SELECT COUNT(*)

AND subtypes NOT LIKE '%Angel%';

SELECT c.*
FROM cards c

SELECT

    id

    cards

    isStorySpotlight = 1 AND isTextless = 0

SELECT COUNT(*)

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM cards

SELECT fd.name

SELECT (COUNT(CASE WHEN c.hasContentWarning = 0 THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*)) AS percentage
FROM cards c
JOIN legalities l ON c.uuid = l.uuid

SELECT 
    (COUNT(CASE WHEN f.language = 'French' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*)) AS percentage
FROM 
    cards c
LEFT JOIN 
    foreign_data f ON c.uuid = f.uuid
WHERE 
    c.power IS NULL OR c.power = '*';

SELECT DISTINCT fd.language
FROM foreign_data fd
JOIN sets s ON s.code = 'ARC'
JOIN cards c ON c.uuid = fd.uuid
WHERE s.name = 'Archenemy';

SELECT f.*
FROM cards c
JOIN foreign_data f ON c.uuid = f.uuid
WHERE c.name = 'Ancestor''s Chosen' AND f.language = 'Korean';

SELECT c.name, s.isForeignOnly

SELECT COUNT(*)

SELECT flavorText

SELECT fd.text 
FROM foreign_data fd

WHERE c.setCode = 'Coldsnap' AND fd.language = 'Italian';

SELECT fd.name
FROM cards c
JOIN foreign_data fd ON c.uuid = fd.uuid

    SELECT MAX(convertedManaCost)
    FROM cards
    WHERE setCode = 'Coldsnap'
);

SELECT 
    (COUNT(CASE WHEN cardKingdomFoilId IS NOT NULL AND cardKingdomId IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) * 100.0) / COUNT(*) AS percentage_incredibly_powerful
FROM 
    cards
WHERE 
    setCode = 'Coldsnap';

SELECT l.format, GROUP_CONCAT(c.name) AS banned_cards
FROM legalities l
JOIN cards c ON l.uuid = c.uuid
WHERE l.status = 'Banned'
GROUP BY l.format
HAVING COUNT(l.status) = (
    SELECT MAX(banned_count)
    FROM (
        SELECT COUNT(*) AS banned_count
        FROM legalities
        WHERE status = 'Banned'
        GROUP BY format
    )
);

SELECT DISTINCT frameVersion, c.*
FROM cards c
WHERE c.artist = 'Allen Williams'
   OR c.uuid IN (SELECT uuid FROM legalities WHERE status = 'Banned');

SELECT AVG(oxygen_count) AS average_oxygen_atoms
FROM (
    SELECT m.molecule_id, COUNT(a.atom_id) AS oxygen_count
    FROM molecule m
    JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
    JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
    JOIN atom a ON c.atom_id2 = a.atom_id
    WHERE b.bond_type = '-' AND a.element = 'o'
    GROUP BY m.molecule_id
);

SELECT AVG(single_bond_count) AS average_single_bonded_carcinogenic_molecules
FROM (
    SELECT m.molecule_id, COUNT(b.bond_id) AS single_bond_count
    FROM molecule m
    JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
    WHERE m.label = '+' AND b.bond_type = '-'
    GROUP BY m.molecule_id
);

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id, m.label
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#' AND m.label = '+';

SELECT 
    (COUNT(CASE WHEN a.element = 'c' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(a.atom_id)) AS carbon_percentage
FROM 
    atom a
JOIN 
    bond b ON a.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE 
    b.bond_type = '='
GROUP BY 
    a.molecule_id;

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM atom a
JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id OR a.atom_id = c.atom_id2
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '='

SELECT label, COUNT(label) AS label_count
FROM molecule
WHERE molecule_id IN (
    SELECT molecule_id
    FROM atom
    WHERE element = 'h'
)
GROUP BY label
ORDER BY label_count DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT element, COUNT(element) AS element_count
FROM atom
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '-'
GROUP BY element
ORDER BY element_count ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.atom_id) AS atom_count
FROM atom a
JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id OR a.atom_id = c.atom_id2
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE (a.element = 'i' OR a.element = 's') AND b.bond_type = '-';

SELECT 
    (COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id) - SUM(CASE WHEN a.element = 'f' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id) AS percentage_non_fluorine
FROM 
    molecule m
LEFT JOIN 
    atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE 
    m.label = '+';

SELECT 
    (SUM(CASE WHEN b.bond_type = '#' AND m.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0) / 
    NULLIF(COUNT(b.bond_id), 0) AS percent
FROM 
    bond b
JOIN 
    molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id;

SELECT bond_type, COUNT(bond_type) AS bond_count, 
       (SELECT carcinogenic FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id = 'TR010') AS is_carcinogenic
FROM bond
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR010'
GROUP BY bond_type
ORDER BY bond_count DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM connected 
WHERE (atom_id = 'TR009_12' OR atom_id2 = 'TR009_12') 
AND bond_id IN (SELECT bond_id FROM bond WHERE molecule_id = 'TR009');

SELECT m.label
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = ' = '
GROUP BY m.molecule_id
ORDER BY COUNT(b.bond_id) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT a1.atom_id, a1.element
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE b.molecule_id = 'TR041' AND b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT DISTINCT a.element 
FROM atom a 
JOIN bond b ON a.molecule_id = b.molecule_id 
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR144_8_19';

SELECT COUNT(a.atom_id) AS total_atoms
FROM atom a
JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id OR a.atom_id = c.atom_id2
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#' AND (a.element = 'p' OR a.element = 'br');

SELECT 
    (SUM(CASE WHEN a.element = 'cl' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(a.atom_id)) AS percent
FROM 
    atom a
JOIN 
    bond b ON a.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE 
    b.bond_type = '-'
GROUP BY 
    a.molecule_id;

SELECT a.element, COUNT(*) AS tally
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+' AND substr(a.atom_id, 7, 1) = '4'
GROUP BY a.element;

SELECT MAX(frpm.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)`) AS Highest_Eligible_Free_Rate
FROM frpm
JOIN satscores ON frpm.CDSCode = satscores.cds
WHERE (satscores.NumGE1500 * 1.0 / satscores.NumTstTakr) > 0.3
AND frpm.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` > 0;

SELECT s."Charter School Number", AVG(sa.AvgScrWrite) AS Average_Writing_Score
FROM satscores sa
JOIN schools s ON sa.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE sa.AvgScrWrite > 499 AND s."Charter School Number" IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY s."Charter School Number"

SELECT s.School AS School_Name, s.Street, s.City, s.Zip, s.State
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE ABS(f.`Enrollment (K-12)` - f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) > 30;

SELECT s.School
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
JOIN satscores sa ON s.CDSCode = sa.cds
WHERE (f.Free Meal Count (K-12) / f.Enrollment (K-12)) > 0.1

SELECT s.School, s.FundingType
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores sa ON s.CDSCode = sa.cds
WHERE s.City = 'Riverside'
GROUP BY s.School, s.FundingType
HAVING AVG(sa.AvgScrMath) > 400;

SELECT s.School AS School_Name, 
       s.Street || ', ' || s.City || ', ' || s.State || ' ' || s.Zip AS Full_Communication_Address
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.County = 'Monterey' 
  AND f.FRPM_Count_Ages_5_17 > 800;

SELECT s.School AS School_Name, AVG(sa.AvgScrWrite) AS Average_Writing_Score, s.Phone AS Communication_Number
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores sa ON s.CDSCode = sa.cds
WHERE (s.OpenDate > '1991-01-01' OR s.ClosedDate < '2000-01-01')
GROUP BY s.School, s.Phone;

WITH EnrollmentDifference AS (
    SELECT 
        f.CDSCode,
        f.`School Name`,
        f.`Enrollment (K-12)` - f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` AS Difference
    FROM 
        frpm f
    JOIN 
        schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
    WHERE 
        s.FundingType = 'Locally Funded'
),
AverageDifference AS (
    SELECT 
        AVG(Difference) AS AvgDiff
    FROM 
        EnrollmentDifference
)
SELECT 
    ed.`School Name`,
    s.DOCType
FROM 
    EnrollmentDifference ed
JOIN 
    AverageDifference ad ON ed.Difference > ad.AvgDiff;

SELECT 
    `School Name`, 
    (`Free Meal Count (K-12)` / `Enrollment (K-12)`) AS Eligible_Free_Rate
FROM 
    frpm
WHERE 
    `Low Grade` <= '1' AND `High Grade` >= '12'
ORDER BY 
    `Enrollment (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 2 OFFSET 9;

SELECT 
    s.SchoolName,
    (f.`FRPM Count (K-12)` / f.`Enrollment (K-12)`) AS EligibleMealRate
FROM 
    frpm f
JOIN 
    schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE 
    s.Charter = 66 
    AND f.`Low Grade` <= '1' 
    AND f.`High Grade` >= '12'
ORDER BY 
    f.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT s.Street, s.City, s.Zip, s.State
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores sa ON s.CDSCode = sa.cds
WHERE sa.NumTstTakr > 0
ORDER BY (sa.NumGE1500 * 1.0 / sa.NumTstTakr) ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.AdmFName1 || ' ' || s.AdmLName1 AS FullName
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores sa ON s.CDSCode = sa.cds
WHERE sa.NumGE1500 = (
    SELECT MAX(NumGE1500)
    FROM satscores
)

SELECT AVG(s.NumTstTakr) AS AverageTestTakers
FROM schools sch
JOIN satscores s ON sch.CDSCode = s.cds
WHERE sch.City = 'Fresno' 
AND sch.OpenDate BETWEEN '1980-01-01' AND '1980-12-31';

SELECT s.Phone
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores sa ON s.CDSCode = sa.cds
WHERE s.District = 'Fresno Unified'
ORDER BY sa.AvgScrRead ASC
LIMIT 1;

WITH RankedSchools AS (
    SELECT 
        s.School AS SchoolName,
        s.County AS CountyName,
        sa.AvgScrRead,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.County ORDER BY sa.AvgScrRead DESC) AS Rank
    FROM 
        schools s
    JOIN 
        satscores sa ON s.CDSCode = sa.cds
    WHERE 
        s.Virtual = 'F'
)
SELECT 
    SchoolName, 
    CountyName
FROM 
    RankedSchools
WHERE 
    Rank <= 5;

SELECT s.School AS School_Name, AVG(sa.AvgScrWrite) AS Average_Writing_Score
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
JOIN satscores sa ON s.CDSCode = sa.cds
WHERE f.AdmFName1 = 'Ricci' AND f.AdmLName1 = 'Ulrich'
GROUP BY s.School;

SELECT s.State, s.School, SUM(f.`Enrollment (K-12)`) AS Total_Enrollment
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.DOC = '31' AND f.`Low Grade` >= '1' AND f.`High Grade` <= '12'
GROUP BY s.State, s.School
ORDER BY Total_Enrollment DESC;

SELECT AVG(monthly_opened) AS monthly_average
FROM (
    SELECT strftime('%m', OpenDate) AS month, COUNT(*) AS monthly_opened
    FROM schools
    WHERE DOC = 52 AND strftime('%Y', OpenDate) = '1980'
    GROUP BY month
);

SELECT 
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM schools WHERE DOC = '54' AND County = 'Orange') * 1.0 /
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM schools WHERE DOC = '52' AND County = 'Orange') AS ratio

SELECT s.School AS School_Name, s.Street || ', ' || s.City || ', ' || s.Zip AS Postal_Street_Address
FROM satscores sa
JOIN schools s ON sa.cds = s.CDSCode
ORDER BY sa.AvgScrMath DESC
LIMIT 1 OFFSET 6;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS TotalNonCharteredSchools
FROM frpm
JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
WHERE schools.Charter = 0
AND frpm.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)` < 0.18
AND frpm.County Name = 'Los Angeles';

SELECT SUM(`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) AS total_students
FROM frpm
WHERE `School Name` = 'State Special School'
  AND `Academic Year` = '2014-2015'
  AND EdOpsCode = 'SSS';

SELECT s.School AS School_Name, 
       (f."FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)" / f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" * 100) AS "Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (Ages 5-17)"
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.County = 'Los Angeles' 
  AND f."Low Grade" = 'K' 
  AND f."High Grade" = '9';

SELECT f.`District Code`
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.AdmFName1 = 'Alusine'
AND f.`Enrollment (K-12)` > 0
AND f.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)` IS NOT NULL;

SELECT DISTINCT AdmEmail1 AS Email
FROM schools
WHERE County = 'San Bernardino'
  AND City = 'San Bernardino'
  AND OpenDate BETWEEN '2009-01-01' AND '2010-12-31'
  AND (SOC = '62' OR DOC = '54');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS account_count
FROM account a
JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN district di ON c.district_id = di.district_id
JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE di.A3 = 'East Bohemia' AND t.type = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM client c
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'M' 
AND d.A3 = 'North Bohemia' 
AND d.A11 > 8000;

WITH SalaryStats AS (
    SELECT 
        d.A11 AS average_salary,
        c.client_id,
        c.gender,
        c.birth_date,
        a.account_id
    FROM 
        client c
    JOIN 
        disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
    JOIN 
        account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
    WHERE 
        c.gender = 'F'
),
OldestFemale AS (
    SELECT 
        client_id,
        MIN(birth_date) AS oldest_birth_date
    FROM 
        SalaryStats
    GROUP BY 
        client_id
),
LowestAvgSalary AS (
    SELECT 
        MIN(average_salary) AS lowest_salary
    FROM 
        SalaryStats
    WHERE 
        client_id IN (SELECT client_id FROM OldestFemale)
),
HighestAvgSalary AS (
    SELECT 
        MAX(average_salary) AS highest_salary
    FROM 
        SalaryStats
)
SELECT 
    a.account_id,
    (h.highest_salary - l.lowest_salary) AS salary_gap
FROM 
    LowestAvgSalary l,
    HighestAvgSalary h,
    SalaryStats a
WHERE 
    a.average_salary = l.lowest_salary;

SELECT d.account_id
FROM disp d
JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN district di ON c.district_id = di.district_id
WHERE c.birth_date = (SELECT MIN(birth_date) FROM client)
AND di.A11 = (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district);

SELECT a.account_id, l.amount
FROM account a
JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE strftime('%Y', l.date) = '1997'
AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'
ORDER BY l.amount ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT a.account_id, MAX(l.amount) AS highest_approved_amount
FROM account a
JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE l.duration > 12 AND strftime('%Y', a.date) = '1993'
GROUP BY a.account_id
ORDER BY highest_approved_amount DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH SouthBohemiaDistrict AS (
    SELECT district_id
    FROM district
    WHERE A3 = 'South Bohemia'
    ORDER BY A4 DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
ClientCounts AS (
    SELECT 
        COUNT(*) AS total_clients,
        SUM(CASE WHEN gender = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS male_clients
    FROM client
    WHERE district_id IN (SELECT district_id FROM SouthBohemiaDistrict)
)
SELECT 
    (male_clients * 100.0 / total_clients) AS male_percentage
FROM ClientCounts;

SELECT d.A2 AS district, d.A3 AS state, 
       ((d.A13 - d.A12) / d.A12) * 100 AS unemployment_rate_increment
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN client c ON a.account_id = c.district_id
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE l.status = 'D' 
  AND l.date <= DATE('now', 'localtime')
  AND l.date >= '1995-01-01' 
  AND l.date < '1997-01-01';

SELECT d.A2 AS district, COUNT(c.client_id) AS female_account_holders
FROM client c
JOIN account a ON c.client_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
GROUP BY d.district_id
ORDER BY female_account_holders DESC
LIMIT 9;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS approved_loans
FROM loan
JOIN account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
WHERE loan.amount >= 250000
AND account.frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE'
AND loan.date BETWEEN '1995-01-01' AND '1997-12-31'
AND loan.status = 'approved';

SELECT d.A2 AS district_name, SUM(t.amount) AS total_withdrawal
FROM trans t
JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE t.type = 'VYDAJ' AND t.date LIKE '1996-01%'
GROUP BY d.A2
ORDER BY total_withdrawal DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT DISTINCT t.account_id
FROM trans t
WHERE t.type = 'VYBER KARTOU' 
  AND t.date BETWEEN '1998-01-01' AND '1998-12-31'
  AND t.amount < (SELECT AVG(amount) 
                  FROM trans 
                  WHERE type = 'VYBER KARTOU' 
                    AND date BETWEEN '1998-01-01' AND '1998-12-31');

SELECT DISTINCT d.A2 AS account_type
FROM account a
JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A11 > 8000 AND d.A11 <= 9000
AND d.type != 'OWNER'
AND a.account_id NOT IN (SELECT account_id FROM loan);

SELECT *
FROM trans
WHERE account_id IN (
    SELECT account_id
    FROM disp
    WHERE client_id = 3356
) AND operation = 'VYBER';

SELECT 
    (COUNT(CASE WHEN c.gender = 'F' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*)) AS percentage_women
FROM 
    account a
JOIN 
    client c ON a.account_id = (SELECT d.account_id FROM disp d WHERE d.client_id = c.client_id)
JOIN 
    district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE 
    d.A11 > 10000;

SELECT 
    ((SUM(CASE WHEN l.date BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) - 
      SUM(CASE WHEN l.date BETWEEN '1996-01-01' AND '1996-12-31' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END)) / 
      NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN l.date BETWEEN '1996-01-01' AND '1996-12-31' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END), 0)) * 100 AS growth_rate
FROM 
    loan l
JOIN 
    account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN 
    disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN 
    client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
WHERE 
    c.gender = 'M';

SELECT 
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trans WHERE account_id = 3 AND type = 'statement') AS statement_requests,
    (SELECT SUM(amount) FROM trans WHERE account_id = 3 AND k_symbol = '3539') AS total_debit_aim

SELECT 
    (COUNT(CASE WHEN c.gender = 'M' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*)) AS percentage_male_clients
FROM 
    client c
JOIN 
    disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN 
    account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE 
    a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE';

SELECT AVG(l.amount) AS average_loan_amount
FROM loan l
JOIN trans t ON l.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE l.status IN ('C', 'D') 
AND t.operation = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU'

SELECT a.account_id, d.A2 AS district_name, d.A3 AS district_region
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
JOIN card c ON a.account_id = c.account_id
WHERE strftime('%Y', a.date) = '1993' 
AND c.type = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU' 
AND c.issued > t.date;

SELECT a.account_id, a.frequency
FROM account a
JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN district dis ON c.district_id = dis.district_id
WHERE dis.A2 = 'east Bohemia' 
AND a.date BETWEEN '1995-01-01' AND '2000-12-31';
